info.name: Get billing cycle by account token

params.name: account_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the credit account for which you want to retrieve delinquency state details.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts` to retrieve existing credit account tokens.

items.docs: Retrieves the billing cycle details for a specific account token.

info.name: Get all active and upcoming periodic fee schedules of an account

params.name: count
params.description: Number of periodic fee schedule resources to retrieve.

params.name: start_index
params.description: Sort order index of the first resource in the returned array.

items.docs: Get all active and upcoming periodic fee schedules of an account
